title: Among patients with abnormal uric acid levels (above normal for their sex),
question: Among patients with abnormal uric acid levels (above normal for their sex), find those who also had lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) above 600 in any lab test. For each such patient, compute the percentage decrease in total cholesterol (T-CHO) from November to December of 1981, if data exists for both months.

prediction.sql:
WITH AbnormalUricAcidPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE (
        (P.XCL_059 = 'M' AND L.XCL_022 > 8.0) OR
        (P.XCL_059 = 'F' AND L.XCL_022 > 6.5)
    )
),
HighLDHPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE L.XCL_018 > 600
),
QualifyingPatients AS (
    SELECT A.XCL_058
    FROM AbnormalUricAcidPatients AS A
    INNER JOIN HighLDHPatients AS H ON A.XCL_058 = H.XCL_058
),
CholesterolData AS (
    SELECT 
        P.XCL_058,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS NovChol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS DecChol,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN 1 END) AS NovCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN 1 END) AS DecCount
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_058 IN (SELECT XCL_058 FROM QualifyingPatients)
    GROUP BY P.XCL_058
)
SELECT 
    CD.XCL_058,
    CAST((CD.NovChol - CD.DecChol) AS REAL) / CD.NovChol * 100 AS PercentageDecrease
FROM CholesterolData AS CD
WHERE CD.NovCount > 0 AND CD.DecCount > 0 AND CD.NovChol > 0

WITH AbnormalUricAcidPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE (
        (P.XCL_059 = 'M' AND L.XCL_022 > 8.0) OR
        (P.XCL_059 = 'F' AND L.XCL_022 > 6.5)
    )
),
HighLDHPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE L.XCL_018 > 600
),
QualifyingPatients AS (
    SELECT A.XCL_058
    FROM AbnormalUricAcidPatients AS A
    INNER JOIN HighLDHPatients AS H ON A.XCL_058 = H.XCL_058
),
CholesterolData AS (
    SELECT 
        P.XCL_058,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS NovChol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS DecChol,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN 1 END) AS NovCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN 1 END) AS DecCount
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_058 IN (SELECT XCL_058 FROM QualifyingPatients)
    GROUP BY P.XCL_058
)
SELECT 
    CD.XCL_058,
    CAST((CD.NovChol - CD.DecChol) AS REAL) / CD.NovChol * 100 AS PercentageDecrease
FROM CholesterolData AS CD
WHERE CD.NovCount > 0 AND CD.DecCount > 0 AND CD.NovChol > 0

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH abnormal_uric_acid AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.XCL_001 AS patient_id
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE (e.XCL_006 = 'M' AND e.XCL_004 > 7.0)
       OR (e.XCL_006 = 'F' AND e.XCL_004 > 6.0)
),
high_ldh AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.XCL_014 AS patient_id
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.XCL_020 > 600
),
target_patients AS (
    SELECT a.patient_id
    FROM abnormal_uric_acid a
    INNER JOIN high_ldh h ON a.patient_id = h.patient_id
),
cholesterol_data AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_014 AS patient_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN strftime('%m', l.XCL_015) = '11' THEN l.XCL_021
            WHEN strftime('%m', l.XCL_015) = '12' THEN l.XCL_021
        END AS tcho_value,
        strftime('%m', l.XCL_015) AS month
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.XCL_014 IN (SELECT patient_id FROM target_patients)
      AND strftime('%Y', l.XCL_015) = '1981'
      AND l.XCL_021 IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_cholesterol AS (
    SELECT 
        patient_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN month = '11' THEN tcho_value END) AS nov_tcho,
        MAX(CASE WHEN month = '12' THEN tcho_value END) AS dec_tcho
    FROM cholesterol_data
    GROUP BY patient_id
)
SELECT 
    mc.patient_id,
    ((mc.nov_tcho - mc.dec_tcho) / mc.nov_tcho) * 100 AS percentage_decrease
FROM monthly_cholesterol mc
WHERE mc.nov_tcho IS NOT NULL 
  AND mc.dec_tcho IS NOT NULL
  AND mc.nov_tcho > 0

HighLDHPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE L.XCL_018 > 600
),
QualifyingPatients AS (
    SELECT A.XCL_058
    FROM AbnormalUricAcidPatients AS A
    INNER JOIN HighLDHPatients AS H ON A.XCL_058 = H.XCL_058
),
CholesterolData AS (
    SELECT 
        P.XCL_058,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS NovChol,
        SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS DecChol,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN 1 END) AS NovCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN 1 END) AS DecCount
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
    WHERE P.XCL_058 IN (SELECT XCL_058 FROM QualifyingPatients)
    GROUP BY P.XCL_058
)
SELECT 
    CD.XCL_058,
    CAST((CD.NovChol - CD.DecChol) AS REAL) / CD.NovChol * 100 AS PercentageDecrease
FROM CholesterolData AS CD
WHERE CD.NovCount > 0 AND CD.DecCount > 0 AND CD.NovChol > 0
